# MetaForge for a hosted gateway

**Generated by `scripts/build_integrations.py` — do not edit by hand.**

The same skills, commands, agents and hooks as `claude-code/`. The one difference is the gateway address: `claude-code/` offers a local gateway as the default, and this package has no default, so you enter your hosted gateway's address and none is written into the package.

## Install

```
/plugin marketplace add FidelOdok/MetaForge
/plugin install metaforge-cloud
```

Claude Code asks for the gateway URL on first enable. Then run `/mcp`, choose `metaforge`, and sign in with the access secret your administrator gave you. There is no token field: the gateway answers 401 and Claude Code runs OAuth. The gateway needs `METAFORGE_OAUTH_LOGIN_SECRET` set.

### On claude.ai

claude.ai chat ignores a connector whose URL contains a `${user_config.*}` reference, so this package's connector does not appear there; it contributes skills, commands and agents. For the tools, add a custom connector under **Customize → Connectors** with your gateway's address, type it with no punctuation after it, and sign in when asked. Chat ignores agents and hooks; Cowork loads agents.

## Which package

| | `metaforge-cloud` | `metaforge` | `metaforge-local` |
|---|---|---|---|
| For | a hosted gateway | any gateway, local by default | no gateway |
| Address | you enter it, no default | you enter it, local default | none |

Install **one**. The manifest has no way to switch a server entry off, so two packages would offer every tool twice.

## Agents

- `metaforge-flow-planner`
- `metaforge-run-verifier`

## Hooks

PostToolUse, SessionStart: the working rules at session start, and a reminder when a flow proposal or patch is held for a person. Python 3 on the PATH; `METAFORGE_PLUGIN_HOOKS=off` disables them.

## Writes wait for a human

A tool that writes is held for approval, because the hosted gateway sees you as a remote caller. Held calls appear on the dashboard's Approvals page.
